scope: Reviewed auxiliary source conditions and replacement pin roles; not a candidate schematic, MPN adoption or full-cell qualification

semantic_limits: Candidate PG reports power FET fully ON, not the old externally set PGTH voltage threshold
Pin 4 is FLT output, not PGTH input; old divider must not be retained there by positional substitution

notes: RESET permits a pullup to the desired logic rail and wired OR; this is not an unpowered leakage guarantee
RESET is explicitly undefined below VPOR; supply from MAIN cannot independently prove fault assertion when MAIN is off
CT tied to VDD needs a pullup resistor; MR below VDD adds supply current, with only typical internal resistance
Startup tSD is 300 us nominal only; do not add it to tD,max and claim a guaranteed startup maximum

rows.limitation: No interpolation from VIN12 to actual ~3.3 V; no inclusion assumption for changed external control/programming loads
Typical 4.5 uA is at TJ25 C and VDD3.3 V, not across the maximum's numeric domains. Pullup sink current belongs to its own rail, separate from IDD; actual header setup must be bound before admission
This one-sided maximum is not an application signed-current interval or an off-state guarantee

native_fault_pullup.accounting: Existing native branch, not a newly added candidate load; no subtraction or duplicate addition without explicit replacement accounting

limits: Offline pinned transcription, not a PDF parser
Numeric domain coverage does not establish header or whole-circuit applicability
